evidence_frontier: The most recent completed experiment is the 100‑epoch w8 confirmation (seeds 42‑46) which satisfied the preregistered gate (444 ≥ 448‑10). Earlier Exp021 evaluated w8, w12 and w16 on the original seed set and reported aggregate Q.ANT correct counts w8=887, w12=884, w16=897, but w12 has not yet been confirmed on an independent seed set.
analysis: Observation: w8 passed a 100‑epoch confirmation gate using fresh seeds, demonstrating that a local width of 8 meets the predefined performance margin relative to the w16 control. In Exp021, w12 achieved 884 correct versus 897 for w16 on the original seed set, a gap of 13, which is just outside the gate threshold. Hypothesis: If the performance gap is primarily due to stochastic seed variation, then training w12 on a new set of seeds should bring its aggregate correct count within the gate (≤ 10 below w16).
hypothesis: Alpha5 with local width 12, trained for 100 epochs on ECG200 with a fresh seed set, will achieve aggregate Q.ANT correct predictions that are no more than 10 fewer than the width‑16 control under the same conditions.

proposal.title: 100‑epoch Local‑Width‑12 Confirmation on ECG200
proposal.research_question: Does a narrower local representation (width 12) preserve the performance margin relative to the width‑16 control when evaluated on a fresh seed set?
proposal.rationale: w8 has already been confirmed as meeting the gate, but the intermediate width 12 has only been evaluated on the original seed set and fell just outside the gate. Confirming w12 on independent seeds will clarify whether the observed gap is due to random variation or a systematic performance loss, informing future compression decisions without claiming minimal viable width.

procedure: Train Alpha5 models with local_width 12 and local_width 16 on the ECG200 training split for 100 epochs using identical hyperparameters and each of the five fresh seeds
Evaluate each trained model on the ECG200 test split (100 samples) to obtain Q.ANT predictions
Aggregate the number of correct Q.ANT predictions across the 5 seeds (500 predictions per model)
Apply the preregistered gate: candidate_correct ≥ control_correct ‑ 10

proposal.success_criteria: The experiment passes if alpha5_w12.aggregate_qant_correct ≥ alpha5_w16_control.aggregate_qant_correct ‑ 10, where the denominator is 5 seeds × 100 test samples = 500 predictions per model.
proposal.risks: If width 12 does not meet the gate, the compute spent will not yield a confirmed compression benefit and may delay downstream experiments. The limited seed count (5) could still leave residual stochastic variance; however, the gate margin accounts for modest fluctuations. No hardware‑level claims are made, so photonic‑hardware risk is absent.
